extracted.intended_audience: prospective ADB partners, member governments, project implementers, consultants, and the general public
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Asian Development Bank's institutional mission, organizational structure, policy priorities, and operational standards that guide project selection, financing, accountability, transparency, and safeguard requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development Effectiveness and Results
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on results management in its operations, improving the capacities of its developing member countries, and contributing to the global agenda on aid effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB emphasizes results management across operations to maximize development outcomes and strengthen country capacities; see the 'Development Effectiveness and Results' area for related practices and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximizing Development Impact
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB maximizes the development impact of its assistance by facilitating policy dialogues, providing advisory services, and mobilizing financial resources through cofinancing operations that tap official, commercial, and export credit sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and assistance are expected to advance economic and social development impact via policy engagement, technical advice, and resource mobilization (including cofinancing, trust funds, and mobilization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and Accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparency and openness are key to maximizing the development impact of ADB's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB lists 'Transparency and Accountability' alongside Access to Information, Accountability Mechanism, Independent Evaluation, Anticorruption and Integrity, and Ethics and Conduct as institutional pillars that ensure open operations and oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental and Social Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental and Social Requirements (listed as a core institutional area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects must adhere to ADB's environmental and social requirements and safeguards (page lists this as a core element of accountability and project standards; see ADB's dedicated policies for details).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticorruption and Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Anticorruption and Integrity (listed as a core institutional area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB identifies anticorruption and integrity as fundamental to its operations and accountability framework; projects and partners are expected to comply with integrity standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to Information / Openness
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to Information (listed among institutional transparency mechanisms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB promotes openness through access-to-information policies, making documents and data available to stakeholders as part of transparency and accountability practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent Evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Independent Evaluation (listed as a core institutional element).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB subjects operations to independent evaluation to assess performance, results, and effectiveness as part of its accountability and learning processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountability Mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Accountability Mechanism (listed among institutional accountability bodies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB maintains mechanisms to receive and address complaints and ensure accountability in project implementation and safeguards (page lists it as part of institutional accountability infrastructure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics and Conduct
rubrics_metrics.description: Ethics and Conduct (listed as a core institutional area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB sets expectations on ethics and conduct for staff, partners, and operations as part of its governance and integrity framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financing Modalities and Instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB provides loans, technical assistance, grants, and equity investments to promote social and economic development, and mobilizes cofinancing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects may be financed through public and private sector operations, advisory services, and knowledge support; cofinancing from official, commercial, and export credit sources is actively mobilized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financing Partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Building strong partnerships with diverse institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ADB seeks financing partnerships to expand resource mobilization and implementation capacity; partnerships span governments, development institutions, private sector, and trust funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy 2030 Alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB envisions a prosperous, inclusive, resilient, and sustainable Asia and the Pacific and advances Strategy 2030 priorities, including eradicating extreme poverty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and programs are expected to align with Strategy 2030 goals and priorities (e.g., sustainable, inclusive growth; resilience; poverty eradication); Strategy 2030 guides institution-wide priorities and programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority Thematic Areas
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB works across topics such as Agriculture and Food Security; Climate Change; Digital Technology; Education; Energy; Environment; Finance Sector; Fragility and Vulnerability; Gender Equality; Governance; Health; Markets Development and PPPs; Regional Cooperation; Social Development; SDGs; Transport; Urban Development; Water.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project proposals and programs should address one or more of these thematic priorities, reflecting ADB's sector focus and comparative advantage in the region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board Oversight and Approval
rubrics_metrics.description: The Board of Governors is the highest policy-making body; the Board of Directors supervises financial statements, approves the administrative budget, and reviews and approves all policy documents and all loan, equity, and technical assistance operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Significant operations, policies, and financing decisions require Board review and approval, reflecting governance and oversight criteria for ADB-supported activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country and Regional Presence / Country Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB operates through departments, country offices, and subregional programs (resident missions and regional offices listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagement is delivered via country/regional offices and subregional programs — project design and implementation should coordinate with relevant ADB country or regional offices and conform to local engagement practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Results Reporting and Case Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: ADB documents Project Results and Case Studies to show impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects are expected to report results and lessons learned; ADB publishes results and case studies to demonstrate outcomes and inform future programming.
